title: Latitude-aware screening prior: exploiting equatorial coupling
interpretation: The latitude-aware kernel does not beat the uniform kernel (-0.92%).  The latitude-dependent lambdas from Step 122 do not improve prediction.
For low-latitude targets specifically, latitude-aware vs uniform: -0.69% (CI95 [-0.89, -0.43], n=30).
pre_registered_prediction: The latitude-aware TEP kernel (low-lat lambda=5627 km, mid-lat lambda=1450 km, from Step 122) should beat the uniform kernel (lambda=4200 km), especially for low-latitude targets, because the latitude-dependent coupling strength carries predictive information.  This exploits the equatorial ionization anomaly modulation as a predictive feature.
